fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Basin Water-Level ODE (Bulb Turbine)
source: Baker (1991), Tidal Power, Peter Peregrinus; Prandle (1984), Simple theory of tidal power, Phys. Chem. Earth 9:217-228; Charlier (2003), Tidal Energy, Springer

unit.name: Generic Tidal Barrage (La Rance-class, ebb+flood generation)

A_basin.note: Basin/estuary plan area (La Rance ~22 km2); assumed prismatic (constant with level)

tidal_amplitude.note: Sea tide amplitude (half of peak-to-trough range); range = 2*amplitude

N_turbines.note: Number of bulb turbines (La Rance: 24 x 10 MW)

A_turbine.note: Flow throat area per turbine unit (5.35 m runner dia, La Rance)

A_sluice.note: Total sluice gate flow area (used for fast fill/empty)

eta_turbine.note: Bulb (Kaplan) turbine+generator efficiency at design low head, 0.85-0.92

h_min_gen.note: Minimum head for power generation (below this turbine idles); typical 1 m

h_start_gen.note: Head built up by holding before ebb generation starts
